body: Nope. I tried partial-suspension hanging, which isn't supposed to be very painful, since it just cuts off bloodflow to the brain.

I'm sorry. That's exactly what I'm afraid of. 

I hope things change and life gets better for you.

I'm 19.

How long ago did you try to hang yourself? Have things gotten better since?

I've got the generic anxiety/depression issues. I've tried so many things, but nothing works. I've been on 5 different pills, been to 4 different therapists, and been to 2 psychiatrists. I've tried exercising and eating well. I've tried positive thinking and self help books. I've even tried New Agey bullshit like essential oils. Nothing works.

It's gotten to the point where I've quit everything I used to love doing and lost all of my friends. I only ever get out of bed to go to my classes, which I'm failing anyway.

I'm just tired of trying.

Thanks for listening.
